mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases above 2% annualized and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past two months indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST drops by more than 10% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals a strengthening supply side, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 5% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 jobs over the past month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strengthening labor market, which is a positive indicator for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% over the past quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases by more than 0.5% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.
